name: Nimble CRM
description: Connect Claude to your Nimble CRM workspace to handle the manual admin work that piles up and gets skipped — logging notes after a call, updating deal stages, creating follow-up tasks, tagging contacts, setting reminders. Tell Claude what happened and it takes care of the record-keeping immediately, instead of it waiting on someone's memory or to-do list. It can also find contacts, companies, deals, and calendar events, and works within the authenticated user's existing Nimble permissions. Changes and deletions always require confirmation first.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nimble CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nimble CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.nimble.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nimble CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nimble CRM lists 45 MCP tools, including append_contact_field_values, create_call, create_contact, create_contact_note, create_contact_saved_search, create_task, delete_call, delete_contact, delete_contact_note, delete_contact_saved_search, delete_task, and get_account_context.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nimble CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nimble CRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Nimble CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nimble CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nimble CRM is developed by Nimble Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
